summary: Comprehensive testing of UI/UX improvements (glass modal contrast, trip estimator, new page sections) and brand rename to RahazaTrans. Found 1 CRITICAL bug in dark mode theme implementation.

critical_bugs.issue: Dark mode CSS variables not applied to portaled modals - ThemeContext only sets .dark class but NOT data-surface='public' and data-theme='azure' attributes on <html>. This causes .glass-modal to use light mode colors in dark mode (dark text on transparent/light background = UNREADABLE).
critical_bugs.evidence: Modal background: rgba(0,0,0,0) (transparent), text: rgb(10,10,10) (dark) in dark mode. CSS var --glass-bg-strong is EMPTY because selector .dark [data-surface='public'][data-theme='azure'] doesn't match.
critical_bugs.fix_required: ThemeContext must set document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-surface', 'public') and setAttribute('data-theme', preset) in addition to adding .dark class

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL FIX REQUIRED: ThemeContext.js must set data-surface='public' and data-theme='{preset}' attributes on <html> element (in addition to .dark class) so that dark mode CSS variables from public-themes.css are applied to portaled modals. Current bug: Exit intent modal has dark text on transparent/light background in dark mode because --glass-bg-strong is empty. Fix: In ThemeContext useEffect (line 40-45), add: root.setAttribute('data-surface', 'public'); root.setAttribute('data-theme', preset); and in cleanup (line 48), add: root.removeAttribute('data-surface'); root.removeAttribute('data-theme');

success_percentage.frontend_ui: 88% (7/8 items passed, 1 critical dark mode bug)
